first_bad_sha.description: SHA of the first bad commit found by bisection

prev_good_sha.description: SHA of the last known-good commit (commit immediately before first_bad_sha), or null if first commit in range is bad

first_bad_message.description: Commit message of the first bad commit

commits_tested.description: Number of commits tested during bisection

total_commits_in_range.description: Total number of commits in the search range (good_sha exclusive, bad_sha inclusive)

kpi_deltas.description: KPI relative change percentages from grounding: {kpi_name: pct_change}

skip_count.description: Number of commits skipped (SKIP verdict) during bisection
